
```{r}
setwd("E:/Daten(x)/Daten(lw-r)/Abc/Doktorarbeit SJS/Analyse R-Statistics/med withdrawl")

dose_data_withdrawl <- read_excel("Dose table_withdrawl.xlsx", sheet = 2)  

dose_data_withdrawl
```


```{r}
# Neue Tabelle mit Status erstellen
dose_data_withdrawl_status <- dose_data_withdrawl %>%
  # Fokus auf die Kategorie „Einnahme nach Krankheitsbeginn (Tage)“
  filter(Kathegorie == "Einnahme nach Krankheitsbeginn (Tage)") %>%
  # Neue Status-Spalte erstellen
  mutate(
    med_status = case_when(
      is.na(Parameter) ~ "unknown",           # Kein Wert
      Parameter == 0 ~ "med discontinued",    # Abgesetzt
      Parameter > 0 ~ "med not discontinued"  # Nicht abgesetzt
    )
  ) %>%
  # Für jeden Patienten nur eine Zeile mit Status behalten
  group_by(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # falls mehrere Zeilen pro Patient vorhanden
  ungroup()
dose_data_withdrawl_status
```


```{r}
# 1. Status-Spalte erstellen
dose_data_withdrawl_status <- dose_data_withdrawl %>%
  filter(str_detect(Attribut, "_Diclo")) %>%
  filter(Treatment == "Diclofenac") %>%
  filter(Kathegorie == "Einnahme nach Krankheitsbeginn (Tage)") %>%
  mutate(
    med_status = case_when(
      is.na(Parameter) ~ "unknown",
      Parameter == 0 ~ "med discontinued",
      Parameter > 0 ~ "med not discontinued"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`) %>%
  slice(1) %>%   # nur eine Zeile pro Patient behalten
  ungroup()

# 2. Zusammenfassung pro Gruppe
status_summary <- dose_data_withdrawl_status %>%
  count(med_status) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100)

# 3. Kuchendiagramm erstellen
ggplot(status_summary, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = med_status)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, " (", round(percent, 1), "%)")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(title = "Diclofenac_Medication Status After Disease Onset",
       fill = "Status") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

```{r}
plot_data <- dose_data_withdrawl %>%
  filter(str_detect(Attribut, "_Diclo")) %>%
  filter(Treatment == "Diclofenac") %>%
  mutate(Parameter = as.numeric(Parameter)) %>%
  group_by(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`) %>%
  filter(!any(Kathegorie == "Einnahme nach Krankheitsbeginn (Tage)" & Parameter > 0, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(Kathegorie == "Zeitraum: letzte Einnahme bis Krankheitsbeginn (Tage)") %>%
  mutate(Parameter = as.numeric(Parameter)) %>% 
  group_by(Parameter) %>%
  summarise(Anzahl_Patienten = n_distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Parameter, y = Anzahl_Patienten)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(plot_data$Parameter, na.rm = TRUE),
                                  max(plot_data$Parameter, na.rm = TRUE),
                                  by = 2)) +
  labs(
    x = "Time between last drug intake and disease onset (days)",
    y = "Number of patients",
    title = "Diclofenac_Time of drug discontinuation before disease onset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
plot_data <- dose_data_withdrawl %>%
  filter(str_detect(Attribut, "_Diclo")) %>%
  filter(Treatment == "Diclofenac") %>%
  mutate(Parameter = as.numeric(Parameter)) %>%
  filter(!(Kathegorie == "Einnahme nach Krankheitsbeginn (Tage)" & 
           (is.na(Parameter) | Parameter == 0))) %>%
  filter(Kathegorie == "Einnahme nach Krankheitsbeginn (Tage)") %>%
  group_by(Parameter) %>%
  summarise(Anzahl_Patienten = n_distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Parameter, y = Anzahl_Patienten)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(plot_data$Parameter, na.rm = TRUE),
                                  max(plot_data$Parameter, na.rm = TRUE),
                                  by = 4)) +
  labs(
    x = "Time of continuos drug intake after disease onset (days)",
    y = "Number of patients",
    title = "Diclofenac_Time of continuos drug intake after disease onset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
